title: Topologic: Revolver's Deck (lore build)
summary: Topologic is five Link Monsters with no Main Deck, so this list uses the deck of the duelist who wields them in VRAINS: Revolver (Varis), leader of the Knights of Hanoi. His Skill, Storm Access, pulls a Topologic from the Data Storm, and the rest of his deck combines his Rokket, Borrel, and DARK Dragon cards.

summary.title: Starters & Rokket Engine
points: Quick Launch Special Summons any Rokket monster directly from the Deck without using your Normal Summon, and destroys it during the End Phase to trigger its float into another Rokket.
Absorouter Dragon Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Rokket monster, and searches any Rokket monster when sent to the GY.

Sniffer Dragon searches another Sniffer Dragon on summon, while Gateway Dragon Special Summons itself when the opponent controls a Link Monster and summons a Level 4 or lower DARK Dragon from the hand.

summary.title: Opening: Quick Launch + Absorouter Dragon
steps: Activate Quick Launch to Special Summon Magnarokket Dragon or Autorokket Dragon from the Deck, then Special Summon Absorouter Dragon from the hand.
Link Summon Dillingerous Dragon, Booster Dragon, or Quadborrel Dragon using the Rokket and Absorouter Dragon; Absorouter Dragon in the GY searches another Rokket monster.

Normal Summon the searched Rokket (which triggers Dillingerous Dragon to revive from the GY if you made it earlier) and climb into Link-4 Topologic Bomber Dragon, Topologic Zeroboros, or Borreload Dragon.

summary.title: Topologic Zone Detonations
points: Topologic Bomber Dragon destroys all monsters in the Main Monster Zones whenever another monster is Special Summoned to a zone any Link Monster points to, and burns the opponent for the original ATK of any monster it attacks.
Topologic Trisbaena banishes any monster Special Summoned to a zone it points to along with all Spells and Traps on the field, burning the opponent for 500 per card banished by its effect.

Topologic Zeroboros gains 200 ATK for every banished card, banishes the entire field when a monster is Special Summoned to a zone any Link Monster points to, and returns during the next Standby Phase.

summary.title: Borrel Bosses & Rokket Bullets
points: Borreload Dragon, Borrelsword Dragon, and Borrelguard Dragon target a monster on the field as a Quick Effect without letting the opponent respond: targeting your own Magnarokket, Metalrokket, Autorokket, Silverrokket, Shelrokket, or Anesthrokket Dragon makes that Rokket destroy itself to remove an opponent's card and summon a new Rokket in the End Phase.

Twin Triangle Dragon, Triple Burst Dragon, Vorticular Drumgon, and Borreload eXcharge Dragon round out Revolver's Extra Deck links and rank-ups, while Cracking Dragon punishes lone summons with ATK reduction and burn.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Left out
points: Boot Sector Launch Special Summons up to 2 Rokket monsters with different names from the hand, or up to the difference in monster count from the GY.
Squib Draw destroys a Rokket monster you control to draw 2 cards while triggering that Rokket's End Phase float, and Borrel Regenerator revives a Rokket and draws 1 card when destroyed.
Mirror Force Launcher searches or recycles Revolver's signature Mirror Force, and Topologic Gumblar Dragon (his Extra Link hand-loop boss) is omitted because it is Forbidden.

extra: Topologic Bomber Dragon
Link-4: wipes the Main Monster Zones when a monster lands where a Link points.
Topologic Trisbaena
Link-3: banishes arrivals in its zones and all Spells/Traps, with burn.
Topologic Zeroboros
Link-4: banishes the whole field, then returns.
Borreload Dragon
Link-4: shrinks a monster with no response; steals what it attacks.
Borrelsword Dragon
Link-4: attacks twice and halves what it hits.
Borrelguard Dragon
Link-4: can't be destroyed by effects; revives a destroyed monster.
Twin Triangle Dragon
Link-2 of two small Dragons: revives a Level 5+ monster.
Booster Dragon
Link-2 of two Rokkets: pumps a monster; revives a Dragon when it falls.
Quadborrel Dragon
Link-2: destroys a monster; revives Rokkets if it was a Link.
Triple Burst Dragon
Link-3: negates in the Damage Step; brings back a small Link.
Vorticular Drumgon
Link-3 of three DARK Dragons: draws when summoned.
Borreload eXcharge Dragon
Rank 4 for two DARK Dragons: shrinks a monster and revives a Borrel.
Dillingerous Dragon
Link-2 for DARK Dragons: revives itself when a Rokket arrives.
